title: Pantalone Privacy Policy
content:
Last updated: 1 April 2026

Pantalone iOS

This Privacy Policy applies exclusively to the Pantalone iOS app (the App), available on the Apple App Store. It does not apply to the Pantalone website or any web-based versions of Match or Slide, which are covered by a separate privacy policy.

About the App

Pantalone is a puzzle game app developed by Samuel Wood, currently offering two games: Match, a card-flipping memory game, and Slide, a tile-ordering puzzle game.

Data Collection

The App itself does not directly collect, store, or process any personal data. The App integrates with Apple Game Center to provide leaderboard and score-sharing features. Through Game Center, Apple may process your Game Center username, game scores, and contacts for Game Center's sharing features. This data is collected and managed entirely by Apple and is subject to Apple's own Privacy Policy, which can be found at apple.com/legal/privacy. Samuel Wood has no access to, and no control over, the data Apple collects through Game Center.

Third Parties

The App contains no third-party advertising, analytics SDKs, or tracking of any kind.

Children

The App does not knowingly collect any data from any user, including children.

Changes to This Policy

If the App's data practices change in future — for example, through the introduction of new features — this policy will be updated accordingly.

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact: hello@pantalone.games

This Website

Pantalone is designed for families, and we require users to be at least 16 years old to create an account. This ensures that users can legally consent to our terms and manage player profiles responsibly.

1. What Information We Collect

We collect only what’s necessary to provide our service:

  • User Account Data: User email address (for sign-ups and logins). Player profiles (to associate Players with Users). Player scores (for your game statistics).
  • Authentication Tokens: Firebase, a Google company, stores your user ID and login session in your browser’s localStorage (not cookies). If you check “Remember Me,” your session persists until you log out or clear your browser data.

CHILDREN AND PLAYERS UNDER THE AGE OF SIXTEEN

Pantalone does not collect data directly from individuals under 16 years of age.

Users of Pantalone warrant that they are over 16 years of age when they register their user account. Users can create up to 4 subordinate Player profiles for individuals under 16 years of age. A User creating a subordinate profile warrants that he/she is the parent or legal guardian of the player when they create the subordinate Player profile.

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Authentication: To log Users in and keep you logged in and provide access to your Player profiles.
  • Our Service: To maintain Player profiles, game scores, averages and personal bests, and family leaderboards. Player profiles and scores are used solely for game statistics and family leaderboards. We do not collect or use this data for any other purpose.
  • Analytics: To understand how our service is used (e.g., which pages are popular, where our visitors are located).
  • Communication: To send you account-related emails (e.g., password resets).

We do not sell or share your data with third parties, except as required by law.

3. How We Store Your Data

  • Firebase: Your account data is stored securely in Firebase’s cloud databases. Firebase, a Google company based in California, is compliant with international privacy standards. Firebase’s servers are located around the world, but we have requested that Pantalone’s user data be stored in northamerica-northeast1 (which is in Canada). You can read Firebase’s Standard Contractual Clauses, which govern its handling of data from users in the European Union and United Kingdom at Firebase’s Standard Contractual Clauses.
  • Netlify: Our service is hosted on servers provided by Netlify. Netlify, a cloud-based server provider headquartered in California, is compliant with international privacy standards. Netlify’s servers are located around the world. When you visit pantalone.games, Netlify routes visitors to the nearest server for faster loading. This means when visitors in Europe come to our site, it loads from European servers, Australians from Australian servers, etc. No personal data is stored on Netlify’s servers, but your data and our content are transferred through them. You can learn more about Netlify at Netlify.
  • LocalStorage: Your login session is stored in your browser (not on our servers). You can clear your browser’s local storage by going to its Settings and clearing its cache and history. This will log you out of Pantalone and remove your saved session. Consult your browser’s Help for full instructions.

4. Your Rights

  • Access/Delete: You can access or delete your account data anytime via your account settings or by contacting us.
  • Questions: Contact us at hello@pantalone.games for any privacy-related requests.

5. Changes to This Policy

We’ll update this policy if we add new features or change how we handle data. Major changes will be announced via email or a site notice.

6. Jurisdiction

Pantalone and its owner Samuel Wood are located in Montréal, Quebec, Canada. It and this privacy policy are subject to Loi 25 and the Code civil de Québec.

7. Contact Us

For questions or concerns, email us at hello@pantalone.games.
